text.en: The 1 2 3 chair by Michael Anastassiades embodies a harmonious blend of sophistication and comfort, emphasizing the purity of materials. Its name whimsically reflects the process of finding the ideal balance in the number of vertical slats adorning the backrest. After thoughtful consideration and testing, three slats were chosen, resulting in a structure that exudes elegance and lightness, embodying a refined synthesis of design principles.

text.en: 45°/Tavolino by Ron Gilad highlights the designer's fascination with geometry and the subtle poetry of simple forms. Each table embodies an “open box” concept, where contours define space without overwhelming it, creating a sense of lightness and transparency. 45°/Tavolino harmonizes with a variety of interiors, as the collection blends sculptural presence with practical versatility.

The 505 Up Sideboard by Nicola Gallizia is a refined evolution of the iconic 505 system, thoughtfully reimagined to meet the nuanced demands of contemporary living. Balancing simplicity with versatility, this sideboard offers endless possibilities for personalization through its diverse front panel combinations.

The 505 UP living system by Nicola Gallizia embodies the spirit of refined modular living, ever evolving to embrace the dynamic demands of contemporary interiors. Inspired by architecture, it shapes spaces with a sculptural presence that captures the geometry and rhythm of urban landscapes. A variety of materials and compositional elements enrich its versatility, inviting personalized expression and storage capabilities in living areas and beyond.

This design balances rigorous structure with customizable variety, where every surface and contour is thoughtfully composed. The collection embodies a contemporary approach to storage and display, combining practicality with aesthetic appeal, creating a bedroom environment that is simultaneously serene, sophisticated, and unmistakably modern.

Designed as a flexible family of storage solutions, 606 invites personalization while maintaining a cohesive appeal within the space.

text.en: The Arc table by Foster + Partners brings architectural poetry to the outdoors in a sculptural expression of strength and lightness. Inspired by the advanced techno-structures of contemporary architecture, Arc translates engineering precision into refined design. Its bold silhouette transforms outdoor spaces with a sense of modern elegance.

Transcending the dichotomy between architecture and design, Architettura tray by Gio Ponti reveals the two disciplines as complementary and inseparable forces. Inspired by architectural principles, its hexagonal shape recalls a form that has long been central to Ponti’s architectural explorations. Ponti consistently interpreted his surroundings through an architectural lens, channeling that vision to create beauty in everyday life.

The Aria writing desk by Vincent Van Duysen blends lightness and strength, designed to integrate seamlessly into any living space. With its refined silhouette and meticulous attention to detail, Aria embodies a contemporary aesthetic while offering a highly functional workspace.

text.en: The Arial boiserie and door system by Studio Klass is inspired by the iconic Arial typeface, known for its clean lines and effortless readability. The system seamlessly blends into any living space, serving as a versatile backdrop for everyday life. From its distinctive decorative panels to its versatile door configurations, Arial pushes the boundaries of the traditional boiserie and offers bespoke solutions tailored to each space's unique contours.

A design by Christophe Delcourt, the Armand armchair defined by a precise balance between fine upholstery, a solid structure, and expert craftsmanship. Its form is built around a thin metal shell that wraps the backrest and extends to embrace the chair as a whole, giving the piece a contained profile with a clear construction.

text.en: Inspired by the sculptural form of the Asterias cactus native to the mountainous regions of Mexico, the Asterias table by Patricia Urquiola transforms natural geometry into refined, contemporary design. The table's generous round top and central base mimic the radial symmetry of the cactus, creating a striking yet harmonious presence in any dining or gathering space. Asterias is a bold blend of natural inspiration and meticulous craftsmanship.

The Atelia chair by GamFratesi is conceived around the concepts of care, proportion, and closeness to the body. Its design focuses on the seated experience, supporting without rigidity in a design that is composed without appearing formal. Compact and measured, the chair's silhouette allows it fit naturally into dining and living contexts alike.

text.en: The Intersection kitchen by Vincent Van Duysen transforms natural stone into an architectural centerpiece. Inspired by the fascination of monolithic forms, this kitchen embodies the elegance of a single material, sculpted with precision to create an object that is at once functional and visually striking.

finishes: Vincent Van Duysen’s project, Intersection, is a kitchen that exudes
a strong expressive character while showcasing the brand’s excel-
lence in material processing. Van Duysen was inspired by the great
masters, Piet Mondrian and Carlo Scarpa for the use of geome-
tric compositions and for the refined materials. Intersection offers
a versatile system that allows for endless linear, corner, or island
compositions, where the interplay of surfaces and worktops cre-
ates captivating plays of light and shadow. The inlay work on the
doors enhances the materiality of the essences and elevates the
lacquered surfaces to architectural heights, dominated by geome-
tric proportions. The snack element presents intersecting vein sur-
faces, resulting in a sleek and rational profile. This sculptural detail
incorporates a channel below its edge, enabling doors and drawers
to open seamlessly without handles. Intersection is also available in
a monomateric version, where the fascination of monolithic objects
made of a single material has inspired Vincent Van Duysen, to cre-
ate a unique, sculptural, and architectural object.

text.en: VVD, a signature kitchen by Vincent Van Duysen, embodies a refined balance between functional precision and understated elegance. Known for its refined details, VVD features enhancements that deepen its sculptural presence while maintaining its timeless, contemporary character. Each element is carefully conceived to celebrate both craftsmanship and the tactility of its materials.

finishes: Among all the kitchens it is undoubtedly the one with the most ela-
borate details and unique components. The upper outline of the
cabinet door in aluminium defines the facade, thanks to its ergo-
nomic profile available in three metallic finishes. The terminal pa-
nels give a distinctive touch to the final part of the counter- tops,
while the finger recessed provides a clean and elegant design.
Open bases, an external sink, and trays beneath the countertops
complete the overall design. Vincent Van Duysen reinterprets the
finger recess detail in a modern and sophisticated manner. The
slim side and end units contrast with the substantial thickness
of the worktops, whose linearity is interrupted by sculptural sto-
ne sink bowls. Additional end panels for VVD are available in the
highlighting its thickness in a singular interaction of proportions.
The combination of differ- ent materials and interplay of solids
and voids create a dynamic and sophisticated kitchen.

text.en: The VVD Wall Unit by Vincent Van Duysen is a streamlined storage element that can be integrated into any Molteni&C Dada Engineered kitchen. Designed with a 19 mm thick aluminum frame, it features doors in bronze or matte lacquer in an array of colors, as well as in 4mm thick tempered transparent glass in transparent, extra-clear, or smoked finishes.
Rooted in the Nordic tradition of fine woodworking, the Walter armchair by Vincent Van Duysen is a compact design that distills warmth and simplicity into a contemporary form.

Conceived as a striking companion piece, the When coffee table by Rodolfo Dordoni moves fluidly between the living and bedroom areas of the home. Defined by its sculptural simplicity and crafted in solid wood, When is as much an expression of design culture as it is a furnishing accessory.

finishes: eucalyptus - graphite oak - black oak - coffee oak

text.en: The Wing system elegantly redefines the kitchen and living space with its versatile interplay of backsplashes, shelves, and integrated lighting. Designed as a flexible architectural element, Wing offers both practical function and beauty for kitchen worktops or within other living areas. Its thoughtful design enhances everyday storage creating a refined living experience.

The Wish bed by Rodolfo Dordoni creates timeless elegance through a refined combination of wood, texture, and detail. Wish celebrates the natural warmth of solid timber and transforms the bedroom into a sanctuary of calm and comfort. Its understated lines and careful proportions inspire relaxation while highlighting a discerning commitment to craftsmanship and enduring design.
